pipeline.name: Doctoral post, commercial determinants of health
pipeline.institution: Department of Public Health Sciences, Stockholm University
pipeline.next_action: Send the Storbjork email and the one to director of studies Sara Brolin Laftman. Both are drafted and unsent. Check the transcript for the credit values of the Qualitative and Quantitative Research Methods modules first, because the post requires at least 7.5 advanced-level methods credits.

Open question: degree conferral pending against "requirements met by the deadline". Pack in OUTPUTS/StockholmU_PhD_CDH_2026-10.

pipeline.name: DAAD Research Grants, Doctoral Programmes in Germany
pipeline.institution: DAAD, via the Regional Office in Hanoi
pipeline.next_action: Get DAAD to confirm in writing that the Dr. sc. hum. is fundable, draft the supervision and ethics letter for Mueller to sign, and cut the proposal from nine pages to about seven so the previous-research section fits the ten-page combined limit.
pipeline.notes: Funding runs from October 2027. DAAD excludes Dr. med., Dr. med. vet. and Dr. med. dent. from funding and funds Dr. rer. nat., Dr. rer. medic. and Dr. rer. med., so Mueller's suggestion that the Dr. med. is the easier route would make the application ineligible. Verified document limits: CV 3 pages, motivation letter 1-2, proposal plus previous research 10 total, agreed schedule, supervision letter, degree certificate with final grades, one academic reference. Pending MPH conferral against the degree certificate requirement is unresolved.

pipeline.name: Doctoral post, heat, cold and air pollution in pregnancy
pipeline.institution: Institute of Environmental Medicine, Karolinska Institutet
pipeline.next_action: Decide whether to submit at all. Fit was scored 2 of 5 and KI approves no exception to its English 6 requirement, so this needs either an approved test or the medical-degree route, which turns on the WDOMS entry for University of Medicine Magway recording English as the only language of instruction and on the exact 2016 MBBS conferral date.

pipeline.name: Implementation research route, supervisor-led
pipeline.institution: Lead targets Sydney (Greg Fox), Burnet Institute via Monash (Myanmar Program), LSTM (Sally Theobald)
pipeline.next_action: Book IELTS Academic. Then send three emails with the implementation research statement attached: Greg Fox at Sydney (RTP International round for Research Periods 3-4 closes 18 December), Kyu Kyu Than at Burnet's Myanmar Program (Monash round 1 closes 28 February 2027), and Sally Theobald at LSTM (no studentship attached, so ask the funding question).
pipeline.notes: Runs beside the TB-and-conflict route. The topic follows the supervisor's funded project; the statement offers three directions (A case finding under health system disruption, B integrated services for people who use drugs, C acceptability and use of primary care in climate-exposed settings). Eighteen targets scored on 6 October 2026, rows 20-37 in PhD_Board_rows_IR_Route_2026-10-06.xlsx. Other dated windows: NUS SSHSPH 1 November 2026 (choose Siyan Yi or Rayner Tan as the named advisor), LMU CIH 31 January 2027, ITM predoctoral grant 1 February 2027 (Sara Van Belle as mentor), McMaster PhD Global Health 14 February 2027 (portal opens 15 November). The deadline shown is the Sydney round. Pack in OUTPUTS/PhD_ImplementationResearch_Route_2026-10.

pipeline.name: Dr. sc. hum., supervision agreed with Olaf Mueller
pipeline.next_action: Get an ECTS or credit-value statement from BRAC. It is the blocking document for Heidelberg admission and it answers the Stockholm methods credit question at the same time.
pipeline.notes: Mueller agreed to supervise and to sign the DAAD supervision and ethics letter, on condition that Muang drafts it. Denkinger declined for lack of capacity and that route is closed. Yesim Tozan would advise on the panel component. Heidelberg's Dr. sc. hum. rules generally exclude a medical degree alone and admit medical graduates holding a relevant non-clinical Master's of at least 120 ECTS, with a conditional route at 60 ECTS plus 60 of extra coursework. The BRAC MPH states no credit values.
